name: DfamPerc
description: DFAM-inspired mutant percussion for NTS-3. Dual oscillators (sync/FM), noise, and a snappy age-based envelope through a resonant LPF, sequenced over 8 pitch/velocity steps. Hold to run; X = noise/FM grit, Y = decay punch.

params.name: GRIT
params.detail: Noise amount and audio-rate FM/sync grit

params.name: PENV
params.detail: Pitch envelope depth for kick/tom sweeps
